CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
November 1, 2023 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
----------------------------------------------------------------------

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval for October 4, 2023, Planning Commission meetings.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Aberash A.
  Ashebirr for Special Use Permit No. SP23-00008 to allow Shared
  Parking for Infrequent Users for a proposed Adult Day Care within
  an existing Church on an C-2 (General Commercial) zoned property
  at 4808 West 99th Street.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2023-119; and
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SP23-00008 subject to
  21 conditions.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by J.D.
  Thompson,representing Los Angeles Funeral Services, Inc. for
  Special Use Permit No. SP23-00017 to allow a mortuary in an
  approximately 4,200 square-foot one-story commercial building
  on an approximately 5,200 square-foot M-1 (Light Manufacturing)
  zoned property at 323 East Beach Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2023-108; and
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SP23-00017 subject
  to 11 conditions.
  Item 6b Documents

  c. A public hearing to consider an application by Winston Liu for
  Special Use Permit No. SP23-00020 to allow interior and exterior
  modifications to an existing automated car wash facility on an
  approximately 30,600 square-foot lot on an MU-C (Mixed-Use
  Corridor) zoned property at 3245 Imperial Highway.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2023-111; and
  2)Adopt the attached resolution approving SP23-00020 subject to
  12 conditions.
  Item 6c Documents
   d. A public hearing to consider an application by Keokia Childress
  for Special Use Permit No. SP23-00023 to allow 1) large assembly
  use for a bingo hall and 2) Alternative Modes of Transportation
  on an approximately 33,500 square-foot, C-S (Commercial Service)
  zoned property at 685 South La Brea Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1)Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2023-118; and
  2)Adopt the attached resolution approving SP23-00023 subject to
  18 conditions.
  Item 6d Documents

  e. A public hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment No. ZCA23-
  00006 (ZCA23-00006) to establish Accessory Dwelling Unit
  Regulations in Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code,
  Citywide.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2023-031; and
  2) Adopt a Resolution Recommending approval of Zoning  Code
  Amendment No. ZCA23-00006.
  Item 6e Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARING:
  a. A non-public hearing to consider an application by Leon Benrimon
  representing 317 La Brea, LLC, for Design Review No. DR23-00031
  to allow the construction of a mixed use development that

  H-C (Historic Core)zoned property at 317 South La Brea

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2022-103; and
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving DR23-00031 subject to
  7 conditions.
  Item 7a Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester

MINUTES
  INGLEWOOD PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 1, 2023

(1) PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:
The City of Inglewood Planning Commission held its Planning
Commission meeting on Wednesday, November 1, 2023, in the Council
Chambers, on the ninth floor, in City Hall.

The Meeting was delayed, while the overflow of Inglewood
Constituents were given seating in Community Room A on the 1st
Floor.

Following the Pledge of Allegiance by Commissioner Fowler, the
meeting was called to order at 7:20 p.m.

(2) ROLL CALL:
Present: Chairman Larry Springs
  Commissioner Carolyn Fowler
  Commissioner David Rice
  Commissioner Aidé Trejo
  Commissioner Cheryl Shaw-Williams

Staff:  Christopher E. Jackson, DSD Director
  Mindy Wilcox, AICP, Planning Manager
  Michael Pan, Assistant City Attorney
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Senior Planner
  Bernard McCrumby, Senior Planner
  Christine Rivera, Planner
  Arturo Salazar, Planner
  Evangeline Lane, Secretary
  Sean May, Planning Technician
  Brian Espinoza, Planning Technician

(3) STAFF COMMUNICATIONS:
Ms. Wilcox, Planning Manager stated Staff received one piece of
communication for Item 6B, from the Los Angeles County Sanitation
Districts. Also note there is a revised resolution for Item 6D,
which has been both posted on-line, and with copies placed with
the planning commission and here for the public to view. Also
would like to note staff has their revised recommendation format
in the staff report that breaks out the different options, let
us know if you have any questions on that.

Mr. Jackson, DSD Director made a presentation of flowers to Ms.
Wilcox in announcing that this would be her last Planning
Commission meeting as Planning Division Manager, as she will be
leaving the City of Inglewood. He gave a glowing report of her
years of service to the City of Inglewood here in the Planning
Division and she received applause.

Chairman Springs stated that he believes he is speaking for the
whole Planning Commission as well as for himself to say that they
will miss Ms. Wilcox, and truly regrets the fact that she is
leaving the City of Inglewood, that she will surely be missed and
that he and the Planning Commission wishes her very well.

Each Planning Commissioner had words to thank Ms. Wilcox for her
great service not only to the City, but also to each Commissioner
personally and they each wanted to say farewell and thank you,
along with how much they will miss her.

(4) PUBLIC COMMENTS:
None.
